title: Monotonicity of majority
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb N$, the majority function on $\{-1,1\}^n$ is monotone with respect to the coordinatewise order: if $x_i\le y_i$ for every coordinate $i$, then $\operatorname{majority}(x)\le\operatorname{majority}(y)$.
